en: You made it to the roof! All eight floors in {tower:TIME}.
A fine climb, though your best for this challenge still stands at {tower:BEST}.
That's a new best for this challenge! I'll write it in the records downstairs.
Take the stairs down when you're ready. The attendant will see to your Pokémon.
The wind up here does a climber good. Come and see me after a climb!
